Diana looks at the pantry, then at the Codex, then at you. "We’re going to make it." Haven will survive — because someone learned the land, and wrote it down. One less thing to fear.
Word reaches you, days late: Piper stands accused over what happened to Diana. There's going to be a moot. People are choosing sides.

The moot turns to you. Your vote matters here — and everyone will remember it.

◈ FLASHBACK — Dispatcher's headset
You learned the voice — low, steady, unhurried. 'Panic is just information arriving too fast.' You hear it in your own voice now when it counts.

◈ FLASHBACK — Trail compass
Lost above the fog line, visibility down to your boots. You didn't panic — just held the compass flat, found north, and walked out like it was nothing. It was not nothing.

◈ FLASHBACK — Hard Candy
Butterscotch, doled out like medals — good report card, brave dentist visit, the day the dog died. Small sweetness, on purpose.

◈ FLASHBACK — Reading Glasses
You read the fine print on medicine bottles for Leah next door, because their hands shook. Dosages, warnings, the tiny words that matter. The apocalypse has fine print too.
